information.name: Quiet
information.description: For blogs where the writing is the point: a calm reading column, light and dark, and a contents rail beside long posts.
information.license: MIT. Bundled typeface "Quiet Sans", derived from Pretendard, (c) 2021 Kil Hyung-jin, SIL OFL 1.1 (images/OFL.txt).

item.name: masthead
item.label: Introduction
item.description: The opening band. Direct entry, one item: a title, a line under it, and an image and a link if you want them.

item.name: featured
item.label: Featured
item.description: One post, with its image beside it.

item.name: grid
item.label: Grid
item.description: Posts in a grid, three across.

variable.name: sidebar
variable.label: Sidebar
variable.description: Show the navigation column on wide screens.

variable.name: toc
variable.label: Table of contents
variable.description: Shown beside an article that has headings, and as a panel on narrow screens.

variable.name: reading-progress
variable.label: Reading progress
variable.description: A thin line at the top of the window showing how far down the page you are.

variable.name: lang
variable.label: Blog language
variable.description: The language this blog is mostly written in. Posts detect their own, so this rarely needs changing.

variable.name: home-eyebrow
variable.label: Home: line above the headline
variable.description: A short line above the home headline. Shown only when the headline is set.

variable.name: home-headline
variable.label: Home: headline
variable.description: The home page's opening line. Not used when covers are set, because a cover then supplies the top of the page.

variable.name: home-tagline
variable.label: Home: line below the headline
variable.description: A line below the headline. Shown only when the headline is set.

variable.name: accent-light
variable.label: Accent colour (light)
variable.description: Links and emphasis on light backgrounds. Choose a colour that reads against white.

variable.name: accent-dark
variable.label: Accent colour (dark)
variable.description: The same for dark mode. Choose a colour that reads against a dark background.

variable.name: default-theme
variable.label: Default theme
variable.description: The theme a first-time visitor sees. Their own choice takes over once they make one.

variable.name: prev-next
variable.label: Previous and next post
variable.description: Links to the posts either side of the one being read.

variable.name: related-posts
variable.label: Related posts
variable.description: Other posts from the same category, shown below an article.
